body.heading: Make a face
paragraphs: The flap of the bag is your puppet's mouth. Draw eyes above it and a nose in the middle.
Add paper ears, wool hair, or a crown. Every puppet needs something that makes it special.

body.heading: Give it a voice
paragraphs: Put your hand inside and open and close the flap to make it talk.
Decide your puppet's voice: squeaky, deep, or very, very sleepy. Introduce it to the family.

takeaway: A plain bag plus your imagination equals a brand-new character.
safetyNotes: Paper bags are for hands only, never over anyone's head. An adult helps with glue and any cutting.
